task.description: One task directory under /home/palantirkc/work with its STATE.md; key is the directory name. Properties: directory is the full path of the directory; state_sha256 is the sha256 of STATE.md; title_line is the first line of STATE.md and owner_line the text after Owner: in its first 40 lines (both copied as written, may be long, owner_line may have no value).
task.title: title_line

state_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of STATE.md, from source indexing.

title_line.description: First line of the indexed Markdown file, copied as written.

owner_line.description: Owner field found in the first 40 lines; absent if no field was found.

packet.description: One TASK*.md file under /home/palantirkc/work at directory depth 1 to 3; key is the path below the work root. Properties: path is the full path, sha256 the file digest, title_line the first line and owner_line / state_line the text after Owner: / State: in the first 40 lines (copied as written, may be long, may have no value); task points to the task whose directory name is the first directory below the work root. A reference has two special states. No value: the rule could not build a key (for example a report named REPORT.md has no packet id). The target may not exist as an object: the packet file has another name, or the directory has no STATE.md.
packet.title: title_line

hold.description: Ontology-owned hold, written only by actions. Task references are authoritative; times of application come from the trusted action clock.
hold.title: effect

task.description: Reference to the task object; obtain its full Id from search.

effect.description: Change blocked by this hold; unique among active holds on the task.

until.description: Condition that must be satisfied before lifting this hold; free text, not an expiry timestamp.

status.description: Current hold status; allowed values are declared by its value type.

lift_reason.description: Optional explanation of why the hold condition was satisfied.

set_at.description: Trusted UTC application time when the hold was set; generated by $now.

task.description: Reference to the task object; obtain its full Id from search.

topic.description: Short topic name; only one decision per task and topic is current. Reuse it when replacing that decision.

text.description: The decision being made; state the chosen behavior concretely.

decided_by.description: Who made the decision: user or lead. This is attribution, not authentication.

reason.description: Optional explanation of the decision or why a hold may be lifted.

undo.description: Optional instructions for reversing the decision.

status.description: Current decision status; allowed values are declared by its value type.

supersedes.description: Reference to the previous decision replaced by this current decision.
